answer: Each epoch the engine silently re-opens a few settled tasks as unmarked canaries trawled through the ocean of submissions. Canary answers are cross-compared; matching phrasing beyond chance means one puppeteer reused the same cipher - the hidden template behind its fakes - so the whole cluster forfeits the jade each identity posted as bond. A farm of N puppets must write N genuinely distinct, grade-passing answers, honest work per fake, or gamble its entire stake on netting the same canary twice.
